candidate.name: Blockchain Capital
candidate.discovery_evidence: Current Securitize personnel public material describes Web3 Trading for Blockchain Capital BCAP with eligible investors placing limit orders against BCAP/USDC, Securitize Markets ATS matching buyers/sellers, and atomic wallet-to-wallet Ethereum settlement. RWA.xyz independently identifies BCAP as offered by Securitize and reports current Ethereum and ZKsync tokenization plus transfer activity. This is materially distinct from the already-failed public DEX route and from the semantically incompatible RedStone NAV feed.
candidate.rationale: A regulated secondary trading venue with actual matched BCAP/USDC executions is potentially compatible with the frozen V2A spot-market OHLCV semantics. It is not admitted by this preregistration. Physical qualification must independently establish exact BCAP identity, exact venue/market, public/auditable access to execution data, deterministic timestamp/schema semantics, raw bytes plus SHA-256, and frozen continuity/OHLC/volume QA for the existing cutoff. If market data requires private credentials, is not publicly auditable, lacks sufficient executions/buckets, or cannot distinguish market executions from ordinary token transfers, qualification must fail closed. On-chain token transfers alone may not be reinterpreted as trades without exact execution linkage.
